documents.content:
# Allotment plan 2026

Plot 17B at the Velmora allotments.

- North bed: broad beans and garlic, sown in October.
- South bed: courgettes and three rows of Kestrel potatoes.
- Saskia Drummel waters on Thursdays while I'm away.

Problem: slugs are eating the lettuce seedlings in the south bed.

library.content: Tenancy agreement, Flat 3, 14 Quayside Walk, Velmora. Landlord: Brannock Lettings. Rent: 1,150 per month, due on the 1st of each month. Notice period: either side gives two months' notice in writing. Deposit: 1,725, held by the Velmora Deposit Scheme. Pets: one cat is allowed.

Thermwell Comfort 30 boiler, owner's manual. Normal pressure when the boiler is cold: between 1.2 and 1.5 bar. Below 1.0 bar, top up with the filling loop under the boiler. Have it serviced every 12 months. Fault code F22 means low water pressure.
